items.html: And concerning the beard of ZA, the time of its existence was not well explained to me. However, what I received from my master, of blessed memory, is that at first he has only nine Tikunei de-Dikna, after he is thirteen years; and afterwards, after he is twenty years, when the surrounding lights of Aba, of the Lamed-Mem of the Tzelem, enter, then a complete beard is made for him, in thirteen corrections. And this is the meaning of "until his beard was filled"; for this is also the intention of the priestly blessing, which is the surrounding lights of Aba. And see there.
